title: Course Schedule
summary: Given numCourses and an array of prerequisites, determine if all courses can be completed.
statement: Given numCourses and an array of prerequisites, determine if all courses can be completed. Each prerequisite pair [ai, bi] means course bi must be taken before course ai. Return true if all courses are finishable, otherwise return false.
constraints: [a,b] means b must be completed before a.
hints: A course becomes available only after all incoming prerequisite edges are removed.
Track indegrees and begin with every zero-indegree course.
Repeatedly take one available course, decrement its outgoing neighbors, and enqueue newly unlocked courses.
All courses are processed exactly when the dependency graph has no directed cycle.
editorial: All courses are processed exactly when the dependency graph has no directed cycle.

tests.explanation: Course zero unlocks course one, so both can be completed.
The two courses depend on each other and form a cycle.
